name: apex-dev-skills
description: Apex Insights development skills and plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: apex-scope-loop
plugins.description: Decide -> plan -> loop: SPARC-shaped ADR + phased plan authoring, with autonomous /loop + /schedule execution and per-phase swarm dispatch.

plugins.name: apex-guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic runtime guardrails via PreToolUse hooks: hard-block edits to sensitive paths, deny destructive bash, scan tool inputs for secrets, and compile a declarative YAML policy into enforced matcher config.

plugins.name: apex-agent-team
plugins.description: Agent-team coordination tooling: TeamLint statically audits subagent/agent-team config before a run, and ContextBudget hooks warn before compaction silently drops critical state.

plugins.name: apex-legacy-comprehension
plugins.description: Understand and safely change legacy or AI-generated code: pin current behavior with characterization tests before refactoring, and build a living system map of an unfamiliar codebase in an isolated subagent context.

plugins.name: apex-contracts-reliability
plugins.description: Tool-contract validation + runtime reliability: a PostToolUse ledger that infers per-tool schemas and flags contract drift, plus FlakeGuard detection of non-deterministic agent failures (retries, partial failures, flaky tools).

plugins.name: apex-agent-observability
plugins.description: Trace, replay, and cost-attribute multi-agent runs: hook-driven JSONL AgentTrace, deterministic OrchestrationReplay, and per-subagent TokenLens — pure artifacts, with an optional read-only MCP dashboard server.

plugins.name: apex-rag-memory
plugins.description: Diagnose RAG/embedding/memory lifecycle health: audit chunking, detect embedding-model drift, find stale vectors, and regression-test retrieval recall with a golden Q/A harness. Not a vendor connector — it diagnoses retrieval quality.
